description: Create an Instantly campaign. OpenSDR never activates it: creation sends no activation flag, and the response reports the status Instantly returned (normally "draft"). Two-phase: call without confirm to get a preview and a confirmation_token, show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the token after explicit approval. Honors OPENSDR_READ_ONLY. Demo mode returns simulated:true and makes no HTTP call. Every email body must contain an opt-out line.
name: sdr_create_campaign
title: Create campaign
